title.en: Meta announces Muse Spark Open model weights
title.zhHans: Meta 宣布提供 Muse Spark Open 模型权重

searchSummary.en: Meta announced the Muse Spark Open weights on October 15; the hosted repository requires manual approval and uses Meta’s Muse Model License.
searchSummary.zhHans: Meta 于 10 月 15 日宣布提供 Muse Spark Open 权重；托管仓库需人工批准访问，并采用 Meta 的 Muse Model License。

summary.en: Meta announced the Muse Spark Open weights on October 15; the hosted repository requires manual approval and uses Meta’s Muse Model License.
summary.zhHans: Meta 于 10 月 15 日宣布提供 Muse Spark Open 权重；托管仓库需人工批准访问，并采用 Meta 的 Muse Model License。

narrative.en: Meta describes Muse Spark Open as a multimodal model with 816 billion total and 42 billion active parameters. The Hugging Face host lists weight files, but requires users to request access. The license imposes usage conditions, including a separate agreement for qualifying model-as-a-service providers above a specified revenue threshold. Meta’s performance comparisons and actual independent adoption are not established by these release materials.
narrative.zhHans: Meta 将 Muse Spark Open 描述为总参数 8160 亿、激活参数 420 亿的多模态模型。Hugging Face 托管仓库列出权重文件，但用户须申请访问。许可证附有使用条件，包括特定收入门槛以上且符合定义的模型即服务提供商须另行签约。本轮发布材料无法证明 Meta 的性能比较或独立采用情况。

text.en: Meta announced Muse Spark Open weights on October 15, 2026; its hosted model repository lists weights but requires manual access approval.
text.zhHans: Meta 于 2026 年 10 月 15 日宣布提供 Muse Spark Open 权重；托管模型仓库列出权重，但要求人工批准访问。

text.en: The Muse Model License includes conditions for defined model-as-a-service businesses above a revenue threshold; the weights are not unrestricted open-source software.
text.zhHans: Muse Model License 对超过收入门槛且符合定义的模型即服务业务设有限制；权重并非无条件的开源软件。
